Tamil Nadu CM's Cauvery talks plan sparks political row

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin plans to hold direct talks with Karnataka regarding the Cauvery water dispute. This initiative has ignited a political row within Tamil Nadu, with opposition leaders urging the Chief Minister to reconsider. Meanwhile, a separate report highlights four alleged custodial deaths in Tamil Nadu over five weeks, with the Chief Minister remaining silent on the issue. Another report mentions that the state faces investment hurdles due to issues like airport and sewage infrastructure.
